title: The report of a text-only check of an audited book (mcprep exercises verify --json and --details)
description: What a person would find by looking at the crops of an audited book, found from the project and the text layer of its PDF: the same list for every agent that runs the check on the same project. Findings come in a fixed order: errors, warnings, infos; within a severity by code (the order of the table in docs/AUDIT_A_BOOK.md); then in the order of the book. Pages are zero-based. Plain JSON, camelCase.

exercises.description: Exercise frames checked: the authoritative ones and, without a section filter, the ordinary ones.

sections.description: Sections that hold exercises (the length of `sections`).

solutions.description: Authoritative exercises with a solution region.

ref.description: SECTION:LABEL of the exercise; the section id alone for a finding about a whole section; the frame id for an exercise a person framed.

page.description: The zero-based page to look at, or null.

evidence.description: What the finding rests on: the first 40 characters of the text found, the numbers measured.

findingsOmitted.description: Only in the printed result of the command (not in the --details file): how many findings were left out after the first 300.

sections.description: The sections that hold exercises, in the order of the outline (sections the outline does not have follow, by id).

label.description: The number printed with the section's heading, when its outline entry has one.

firstLabel.description: Of the first exercise of the section in reading order.

gaps.description: The numbers between the first and the last that no exercise has (labels that start with an integer; strays left out).

duplicates.description: Labels that two or more exercises of the section have.
